herb.herbalistscraft.ashleaf.lore: Grey leaves that smoulder rather than burn. Nether locals brew them against the heat.
herb.herbalistscraft.bitterroot.lore: So bitter it makes the jaw ache, but it clears the lungs and the head with it.
herb.herbalistscraft.blackthorn.lore: A thorned scrub of the deep woods. Its bark stains the fingers and slows the blood.
herb.herbalistscraft.blaze_pepper.lore: A pod that pops with heat. Nether travelers chew it to stay awake and stay warm.
herb.herbalistscraft.bloodroot.lore: Torn from the ground it bleeds a crimson sap that closes wounds faster than any needle.
herb.herbalistscraft.cinder_bloom.lore: Petals of ember and ash; it opens only when something nearby is burning.
herb.herbalistscraft.cinnamon_bark.lore: Peeled in curls from a jungle tree, sweet and searing at once. Helps the breath come easy.
herb.herbalistscraft.cleansage.lore: Burned or brewed, it drives rot out of a wound and out of a room.
herb.herbalistscraft.comfrey.lore: Knits bone and skin alike. The older herbalists call it knitbone and hoard it.
herb.herbalistscraft.dawnbloom.lore: Opens exactly at first light and closes at dusk. Brewed, it gives a night back to the sleepless.
herb.herbalistscraft.deadly_cap.lore: One cap will drop a boar. Two will drop the hunter. It glows faintly in the dark.
herb.herbalistscraft.dragonscale_herb.lo: Its leaves flake like scales and refuse every flame. The old texts call it the ward of wyrms.
herb.herbalistscraft.dreamcap.lore: A cave mushroom that smells of warm milk and old songs. Sleep follows it closely.
herb.herbalistscraft.emberroot.lore: It grows only where the ground itself burns, storing that heat in a black, coal-like tuber.
herb.herbalistscraft.feverfew.lore: Small white flowers that break a fever by degrees. Never enough, always welcome.
herb.herbalistscraft.fire_sage.lore: Red-tipped and resinous; burned in a hut it keeps the chill, and worse things, outside.
herb.herbalistscraft.frostmint.lore: Chewing a single leaf feels like swallowing a snowflake. Grows where the air bites.
herb.herbalistscraft.glacier_lotus.lore: It blooms on meltwater pools that refreeze each night. Few herbalists ever see one.
herb.herbalistscraft.golden_chamomile.lo: The smell of a calm evening in a cup. Every herbalist starts here.
herb.herbalistscraft.grave_moss.lore: It feeds on what the earth took. Regrowth gathered from it is potent, and unclean.
herb.herbalistscraft.heartleaf.lore: Its leaves are shaped like the organ they mend, and beat faintly when held.
herb.herbalistscraft.hemlock.lore: Fine-cut leaves that smell of mice and regret. The classic poison of impatient nobles.
herb.herbalistscraft.iceleaf.lore: Its veins crystallise into true ice. Wrapped in cloth, it survives long enough to be useful.
herb.herbalistscraft.ironbark.lore: Bark dense enough to turn a blade. Chewed, it turns a little heat as well.
herb.herbalistscraft.lavender.lore: A cloud of violet on the hillside. Put a sprig in a wound and in a pillow alike.
herb.herbalistscraft.lungwort.lore: Spotted leaves that look like the lungs they clear. The doctrine of signatures, proven right.
herb.herbalistscraft.marshroot.lore: A reed-like root that filters swamp water, and swamp air, into something breathable.
herb.herbalistscraft.moonflower.lore: It opens only under moonlight and closes at dawn, as if the day were an intrusion.
herb.herbalistscraft.moonfrost_berry.lor: Frozen berries that burst with cold, clean meltwater when bitten.
herb.herbalistscraft.nightshade.lore: Purple flowers, black berries, and a reputation. Handle it with gloves and intent.
herb.herbalistscraft.red_clover.lore: A lucky flower of the open plains; its sweetness makes bitter medicine drinkable.
herb.herbalistscraft.silverleaf.lore: Moon-pale leaves that weep a clear, stinging juice. The finest field antiseptic there is.
herb.herbalistscraft.sleepwort.lore: Marsh-dwellers say a single leaf ends an argument. A second leaf ends the conversation.
herb.herbalistscraft.snowbell.lore: White bells that ring silently under snowfall, lulling fever and wakefulness alike.
herb.herbalistscraft.spiritwood.lore: Pale wood from a tree struck by lightning and left standing. It hums when medicine is near.
herb.herbalistscraft.stormherb.lore: It grows on ridges where lightning strikes. The taste is ozone and urgency.
herb.herbalistscraft.sunleaf.lore: Broad and gold-veined, it tracks the sun and radiates that memory long after dusk.
herb.herbalistscraft.sunpetal.lore: Flat gold flowers that face the sun all day and hold a little of it for the night.
herb.herbalistscraft.swiftleaf.lore: Plains runners chew it before a long chase. It makes the legs forget they are tired.
herb.herbalistscraft.thunder_thistle.lor: A spined thistle that crackles when stroked. Handle it with leather between you and it.
herb.herbalistscraft.velvet_bell.lore: Soft, dark blue bells under the pines. Their scent calms a racing heart within a minute.
herb.herbalistscraft.viperweed.lore: Its sap numbs the skin where it touches. Marsh hunters learn to respect the green coils.
herb.herbalistscraft.vitalis_root.lore: A fist-sized tuber humming with raw vitality. Jungles hide it beneath old buttress roots.
herb.herbalistscraft.wardroot.lore: Twisted roots buried at thresholds against frost and ill intent. Brew them for the same reason.
herb.herbalistscraft.wild_ginseng.lore: A root with legs and a face, dug from old forest soil. Worth more than gold to the right buyer.
herb.herbalistscraft.winter_sage.lore: A grey-green survivor of the long dark. It keeps the lungs clear when the cold settles in.
herb.herbalistscraft.witch_hazel.lore: A stringy bark that pulls inflammation out of a bruise like a poultice pulls pus.
herb.herbalistscraft.wolfsbane.lore: Blue hooded flowers grown on high slopes. Hunters say it keeps wolves, and worse, at bay.
herb.herbalistscraft.yarrow.lore: Soldiers of old packed its feathered leaves into wounds to stop the bleeding.
Marshroot boiled with purifying salt. Strips venom from the blood.
medicine.herbalistscraft.antiseptic_salv: A green balm of cleansage and silverleaf. The field dressing of every herbalist.
medicine.herbalistscraft.antiseptic_toni: Cleansage and silverleaf. Drives rot out of a wound from the inside.
medicine.herbalistscraft.berry_tea.descr: Moonfrost berries and red clover. Sweet, cold, and endlessly drinkable.
medicine.herbalistscraft.bitter_tea.desc: Bitterroot and marshroot. Unpleasant, clearing, and it grows where nothing else will.
medicine.herbalistscraft.bleeding_oil.de: Blackthorn and yarrow, perversely combined. Cuts that keep bleeding.
medicine.herbalistscraft.burn_salve.desc: Witch hazel and lavender for cooked skin. Extinguishes the burn and cools what is left.
medicine.herbalistscraft.cooling_tea.des: Frostmint steeped with feverfew. For the long walk under a pitiless sun.
medicine.herbalistscraft.detox_tonic.des: Spiritwood and grave moss in strong spirits. It purges the toxin meter, and then some.
medicine.herbalistscraft.dragonscale_dra: Dragonscale herb burnt with cinder bloom. Heavy, bitter, and worth the burns.
medicine.herbalistscraft.ember_salve.des: Emberroot and fire sage worked into wax. It does not make the wearer fireproof, only harder to burn.
medicine.herbalistscraft.ember_tonic.des: Thunder thistle and ashleaf. The drinker's blood runs hot against flame and frost alike.
medicine.herbalistscraft.focus_tea.descr: A mild dawnbloom cup for long nights of work. No jitters, no brilliance, just clarity.
medicine.herbalistscraft.focus_tonic.des: Dawnbloom drawn through stormherb. The world sharpens; sleep can wait.
medicine.herbalistscraft.frost_lung_toni: Winter sage and ice-bearing leaves. The cold reaches the chest and stops there.
medicine.herbalistscraft.frost_salve.des: A greasy balm of iceleaf and glacier lotus. Rubbed into the skin it turns the cold aside.
medicine.herbalistscraft.healing_salve.d: Bloodroot and comfrey in a wax base. Ordinary, reliable, always worth carrying.
medicine.herbalistscraft.healing_tonic.d: Comfrey and bloodroot in equal measure. Knits flesh, thickens blood.
medicine.herbalistscraft.hemostatic_toni: Yarrow and blackthorn. It stops bleeding, and it stops it hard.
medicine.herbalistscraft.herbal_tea.desc: Chamomile, clover and a little lavender. The first cup every herbalist learns.
medicine.herbalistscraft.hush_tea.descri: Sleepwort, taken carefully. The marsh keeps its own recipes and shares them grudgingly.
medicine.herbalistscraft.minor_healing_t: Bitter root steeped in spring water. Closes small wounds at the cost of an empty belly.
Viperweed and deadly cap drawn into oil. Potent enough that the maker wears gloves.
medicine.herbalistscraft.recovery_tea.de: Feverfew and velvet bell. What you drink the morning after a bad night.
medicine.herbalistscraft.recuperation_to: Dreamcap and grave moss. Deep, healing sleep for the badly hurt - and a heavy head after.
medicine.herbalistscraft.respiratory_ton: Cinnamon bark and lungwort. It keeps the breath coming and holds back the dark water.
medicine.herbalistscraft.sleep_tea.descr: Moonflower, snowbell and a pinch of frost crystal. Sleep comes quickly and stays.
medicine.herbalistscraft.slowing_oil.des: Hemlock and sleepwort. A numbing coat that makes every step an effort.
medicine.herbalistscraft.stamina_tonic.d: Swiftleaf, ginseng and a bite of blaze pepper. Fast legs, and a hunger that follows.
medicine.herbalistscraft.strong_healing_: Vitalis root distilled through heartleaf. A battlefield medicine, and a costly one.
medicine.herbalistscraft.sun_tea.descrip: Sunleaf and its own petals, steeped until the cup glows faintly. A traveller's friend on cold roads.
medicine.herbalistscraft.toxic_oil.descr: Nightshade steeped in seed oil. Crude, cheap, and it works on anything with a blade.
medicine.herbalistscraft.venom_oil.descr: Viperweed drawn a second time through shadow ichor. Almost nothing survives the wound.
medicine.herbalistscraft.vitalis_tonic.d: An old apothecary formula. For a time the drinker simply has more life in them.
medicine.herbalistscraft.ward_salve.desc: Ironbark and wardroot, ground fine. Old herbalists paint it on before bad weather and bad roads.
medicine.herbalistscraft.warming_tea.des: Emberroot and sunpetal. The cup that keeps the cold from settling into the bones.
medicine.herbalistscraft.weakening_oil.d: Wolfsbane, ground into grease. The struck limb forgets its strength.
